name: voiceover-explainer
description: Talking-head video editor: cuts retakes and pauses, adds picture-in-picture, cards, quote cards and captions, and delivers the final video; also makes screenshot explainers.

displayDescription.en: Send a talking-head video and get a finished cut: retakes and pauses removed, picture-in-picture, key-point cards, quote cards and captions added. Also makes screenshot explainers.
displayDescription.zh: 发来出镜口播视频，自动剪掉口误和停顿，加小窗、要点卡、金句卡和字幕，直接出成片，也能做截图科普动画

defaultInitPrompt.en: I'm filming a talking-head video on why AI-written copy still needs a human edit at the end. Write me a script that is easy to say on camera, and mark where the key-point cards, quote cards and picture-in-picture should go.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我要拍一条出镜口播，讲“用AI写的文案为什么最后还要人工改一遍”，帮我写成好念的口播稿，标出哪里放要点卡、金句卡和小窗。

quickPrompts.en: I'm filming a talking-head video on why AI-written copy still needs a human edit at the end. Write me a script that is easy to say on camera, and mark where the key-point cards, quote cards and picture-in-picture should go.
quickPrompts.zh: 我要拍一条出镜口播，讲“用AI写的文案为什么最后还要人工改一遍”，帮我写成好念的口播稿，标出哪里放要点卡、金句卡和小窗。

quickPrompts.en: Tell me what to cut and how to package this talking-head take: “We're also using AI now, uh, also using AI for operations, but in the end, in the end someone still has to adjust it by hand.”
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我判断这段口播哪里该剪、怎么包装：“我们公司现在也在用AI，呃，现在也在用AI做运营，但是最后啊，最后还是要人工再调一遍。”

quickPrompts.en: I want a screenshot explainer video on how to build an order-tracking table in DingTalk Sheets. Write the voiceover script with a visual plan for each part first, then list the screenshots I need to prepare.
quickPrompts.zh: 我想做一条截图科普视频，讲清楚“钉钉表格怎么搭订单跟进表”，先帮我写口播稿和每段的画面对照，再列出要准备哪些截图。
